newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Colly Cotton comfortable with prospectus.
newsitem.headline: Colly Cotton comfortable with prospectus.

text.p: Australia's largest cotton producer, Colycotton Ltd, said on Tuesday it was very comfortable with its prospectus forecast for a A$21.4 million net profit in the year to June 30, 1997.
"We're very comfortable with that number," Colly Cotton managing director David Farley told a Securities Institute function.
Colly Cotton floated in October last year, raising A$107 million. It forecast production in the year to June 30 of 180,700 bales.
Farley later told the function he was also very comfortable with the prospectus's forecast for water resources in 1998.
"We've got three good years of growth in profit in front of us," he added.
